description: This file defines an abstract class 'EntityOperator' for various entity comparison and join operators used in query conditions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes static registration and lookup methods for operators like equals, not-equal, less than, greater than, in, between, and logical operators AND/OR, along with their implementations and utility methods.

classes.name: EntityOperator
classes.description: Abstract base class for entity comparison and join operators used in query conditions within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityComparisonOperator
classes.description: Abstract class for comparison operators handling comparable types and collections.

classes.name: EntityJoinOperator
classes.description: Class representing logical join operators (AND, OR) for query conditions.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Retrieve an EntityOperator by name from the registry.

methods.name: lookupComparison
methods.description: Retrieve a comparison operator by name, cast to EntityComparisonOperator.

methods.name: lookupJoin
methods.description: Retrieve a join operator by name, cast to EntityJoinOperator.

methods.name: entityMatches
methods.description: Check if an entity matches the condition with given lhs and rhs.

methods.name: appendRHSList
methods.description: Append a list of RHS values to the SQL where clause.

methods.name: appendRHSBetweenList
methods.description: Append a list of values for BETWEEN clause to the SQL where clause.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the condition is empty.

methods.name: mapMatches
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a map matches the condition.

methods.name: validateSql
methods.description: Abstract method to validate SQL syntax for the condition.

methods.name: addSqlValue
methods.description: Abstract method to add the condition's SQL representation.

methods.name: freeze
methods.description: Create an immutable representation of the condition.
